name: spec-only-splice-equivalence-tests
body:
The e2e suite isolates the SPEC-ONLY case: (a) an `apg project merge` e2e with a spec-only change-set that asserts the merged authored/transient nodes reach main's DB; (b) a splice e2e that seeds authored/transient rows and asserts a spec-only delta agrees with a full rebuild (spliced `db.lbug` equals a full rebuild, or the splice is refused).

Observable completion: both tests exist in the e2e tier (`tests/project_cmd_e2e.rs`, `tests/splice_e2e.rs`), carry the `#[ignore = "e2e tier: …"]` marker, and distinguish the fix from the pre-fix code. `rust.project_cmd_e2e.e2e.merge_round_trip_start_mutate_verify_merge_rebuild` adds code (Widget) and rescans the branch, so the store advances and the seed guard mismatches — it exercises the code path only. `rust.splice_e2e.e2e.spliced_and_full_rebuild_agree_on_every_table_count` and `rust.splice_e2e.e2e.delta_application_matches_a_full_rebuild` use the code-only `rust.splice_e2e.fixture_graph`, whose authored tables are empty in both DBs, making the authored-table equality vacuous.
